instructions: Recommended 2-step workflow: (1) Call search_history(query="term1 | term2", group_by="session", project=...) ONCE to identify relevant session(s) — do NOT call get_decision_timeline in parallel before checking sessions. (2) Call get_session_digest(session="@<id>") with the short id shown in results to read the full condensed user<->assistant decision stream inline. (3) If you need full text of several truncated turns, call get_document(doc_ids=[id1,id2,...]) ONCE in a single batch (avoid scripting loops or guessing sequential doc_ids; use get_session_context(doc_id) for adjacent dialogue).
